lcPolicies.title: Information security & acceptable use policy
lcPolicies.summary: Updated rules for passwords and MFA, client data on personal devices, AI tools, and reporting security incidents within 24 hours.
lcPolicies.body:
1. Purpose
This policy protects GTF and client information and the systems that process it.

2. Accounts and passwords
Use the company SSO with multi-factor authentication. Never share credentials. Passwords must be at least 12 characters.

3. Client data
Client files stay in approved workspaces (Google Drive, Figma, Jira). Do not store client data on personal devices or personal cloud accounts.

4. Generative AI tools
Do not paste client confidential information into public AI tools. Use only tools approved by IT.

5. Devices
Keep company laptops encrypted, updated and locked when unattended. Report loss or theft to IT within 2 hours.

6. Incidents
Report suspected phishing, malware or data leaks to security@gtf-hr.example within 24 hours.

7. Consequences
Violations may lead to disciplinary action as per the code of conduct.

lcPolicies.title: Prevention of sexual harassment (POSH) policy
lcPolicies.summary: Internal Committee members, how to raise a complaint, timelines and protection against retaliation.
lcPolicies.body:
GTF Technologies is committed to a workplace free of sexual harassment, in line with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013.

Internal Committee: presiding officer, two employee members and one external member. Complaints may be raised in writing within three months of the incident.

The committee completes its inquiry within 90 days. Confidentiality is maintained throughout, and retaliation of any kind is prohibited.
